key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C4A
name: store_data_register_through_pointer
description: Writes a data register value through an address register pointer and returns zero. It is a single store with no library calls, text or hardware access.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C50
name: open_dos_file_handle
description: Calls the DOS library's Open entry through the library base and stores the returned handle through the caller's pointer when the result is nonzero. It returns true when the open call returned zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C66
name: store_data_register_via_pointer
description: Writes a data register value through an address register pointer and returns zero, with no other effects. The same pattern appears as a small field store used by several callers.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C70
name: close_handle_and_clear_record
description: If the handle pointer's stored value is nonzero, closes it through the DOS library; otherwise it reports the internal error text that a file handle was already closed. It then zeroes a 144-byte record starting at the same pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C88
name: close_file_and_clear_buffer
description: Closes a file through the DOS library's Close entry and then zeroes 144 bytes starting at the pointer held in an address register. It returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7CAA
name: read_or_return_zero
description: Returns zero without reading when the requested length is not positive; otherwise it forwards the arguments to the DOS Read entry and returns its result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7D28
name: forward_write_to_dos
description: Calls the DOS library's Write entry through the library base with the arguments it was given, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7FB0
name: cache_standard_input_output_handles
description: Stores the DOS standard input handle in a context record. It also stores the standard output handle unless a suppression flag byte is set, in which case it stores zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:809E
name: invoke_dos_vector_if_clear
description: Calls one DOS library vector only when a context flag byte is clear, and does nothing otherwise. The evidence does not name the library function that is invoked.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:80C0
name: cleanup_and_report_user_abort
description: Runs a cleanup routine and then the error reporting routine with the global message buffer. The referenced text is the LZX user-abort notice.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:80D0
name: emit_message_five_set_flag
description: When a status byte is clear, calls the message routine with the global message buffer and code five, then sets a second status byte to one. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:80EC
name: emit_message_four_clear_flag
description: When a status byte is clear, calls the message routine with the global message buffer and code four, then clears a second status byte. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8106
name: write_to_output_when_enabled
description: Writes through the DOS library's Write entry only when a suppression flag is clear and the stored output handle is nonzero. It does nothing otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8134
name: write_bytes_in_chunks
description: When output is enabled and an output handle is set, writes the requested byte count in pieces of at most 1024 bytes through DOS Write. It calls an intermediate check between pieces and returns eleven if that check fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8158
name: write_chunks_checking_between
description: Writes the requested byte count in pieces of at most 1024 bytes through DOS Write, calling a check after each piece except the last. It returns eleven if a check reports failure and zero when the count is drained.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8164
name: write_fixed_blocks_until_done
description: Writes blocks of 1024 bytes through DOS Write and calls a check between blocks until the remaining count is exhausted. It returns zero on completion and eleven when the check reports failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:818C
name: format_and_write_message
description: When output is enabled and an output handle is set, formats a text line into a context buffer using a helper routine, then writes it through DOS Write with the length measured from its terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:81D0
name: invoke_dos_vector_if_clear
description: Calls a second DOS library vector only when a context flag byte is clear, and does nothing otherwise. The evidence does not name the library function that is invoked.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:81EE
name: invoke_dos_vector_if_clear
description: Calls a DOS library vector only when a context flag byte is clear, and does nothing otherwise. The evidence does not name the library function that is invoked.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:820C
name: read_with_surrounding_routines
description: Runs one routine before and one after a DOS Read call, with extra routine calls around the pair when a status byte is set. The value it returns is not determined by the code shown.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8250
name: read_char_matching_set
description: Reads characters through a helper and echoes each one through the text formatter, returning the first one that appears in the supplied string. Letters are case-folded when the character-class table marks them as alphabetic.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8296
name: read_until_expected_char
description: Reads and echoes characters until the input matches the character at the current position of the supplied string, folding letter case through the character-class table. The matching character is returned.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:82B2
name: read_next_matching_character
description: Advances through the supplied string and reads echoed characters until one matches the current string position, case-folding letters through the character-class table.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:82B6
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns, with no library calls, text or hardware access.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:82BC
name: bracket_routine_with_messages
description: Invokes the message routine with the global buffer, then runs a routine with no arguments, then invokes the message routine again with the global buffer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:82D4
name: open_intuition_compute_ratio
description: Opens the intuition library through exec, looks up layout fields from the returned screen record and divides them to produce a clamped integer ratio. A fallback error value of twenty-three is returned when any lookup fails, and task scheduling is locked around the lookup.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:838C
name: contains_reserved_filename_char
description: Copies an eight-character reference set from a global string and returns one if any character of the supplied string is in that set, or zero at its terminator. The set contains wildcard and punctuation symbols.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:83C2
name: scan_string_for_stack_set
description: Walks a string held in an address register and returns one when a character matches any of eight entries from the caller's stack-passed set, or zero at the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:83C6
name: scan_for_eight_char_set
description: Walks a string through an address register and returns one when a character matches any of eight entries in the set passed on the stack, or zero when the string ends.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:83CA
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero immediately, with no other effects.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8AC2
name: free_memory_block
description: Calls the exec library's FreeMem entry for a block. The block address and size are supplied by the caller and are not visible in this routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8AE0
name: allocate_memory_shrinking_request
description: Attempts an AllocMem request and halves the requested size after each failure, stopping once the size reaches 256 bytes. It returns zero on success, and when every attempt fails it reports an error through the message routine and returns one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8B00
name: allocate_halving_then_fatal
description: Repeatedly halves a size counter and retries an AllocMem request until the size drops to 256 or below. It returns zero when an attempt succeeds, and otherwise reports the referenced fatal insufficient-memory text and returns one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8B24
name: forward_two_arguments
description: Forwards its two arguments unchanged to another routine and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8B40
name: consume_bits_refill_word
description: Discards a number of bits from the LZX bit buffer by shifting it, and when fewer than sixteen bits remain, refills it with the next 16-bit word from the input stream.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8BCA
name: read_bit_field_value
description: Returns the low bits of the bit buffer as a field of the requested width, then consumes that many bits from the buffer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8BF8
name: decode_symbol_eight_bit_prefix
description: Decodes one symbol by indexing a prefix table with the low eight bits of the bit buffer, following child tables for longer codes, and then consumes the code length given by a second table.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8C56
name: decode_symbol_six_bit_prefix
description: Decodes one symbol by indexing a prefix table with the low six bits of the bit buffer, following child tables for longer codes, and then consumes the code length given by a length table.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8CB0
name: reset_bit_buffer_from_input
description: Loads the next two 16-bit words from the input stream into the bit buffer and sets the bit count to sixteen.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8CFE
name: read_block_of_256_bytes
description: Fills a 256-byte block by calling the byte reader once for each position, in order.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8D2E
name: read_bytes_and_sum
description: Reads a requested number of bytes through the byte reader into a buffer and returns their 16-bit sum.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8D60
name: read_lzx_block_header
description: Reads an LZX block header with its code-length tables and allocates the decoding tables with AllocMem, reporting an insufficient-memory error when that fails. For one block type it also checks a byte sum and locks the machine in an endless loop when the check fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8F3A
name: count_newline_characters
description: Counts the newline characters in a zero-terminated string and returns the count.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8F5C
name: invoke_routine_with_one
description: Calls another routine with the constant one and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8F68
name: write_lines_within_width
description: Writes a buffer line by line through the output routine, using a width computed from a stored offset, and reports an error when the abort check signals a break.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8FF0
name: pack_four_nibbles
description: Combines four bytes from a buffer into one 16-bit value by shifting in four bits per byte, and returns it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9016
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns, with no library calls, text or hardware access.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:901E
name: initialize_once_when_clear
description: When a status byte is clear, sets it to one and calls an initialization routine with zero. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9084
name: compare_path_tails
description: Finds the last path separator in each of two paths, then compares the text from those points with a helper. It returns one when the two compare equal.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:90BC
name: check_path_tail_matches
description: Finds the last path separator in a string and calls a comparison helper on the text from that point. It returns one when the helper reports a match.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:90E8
name: test_helper_result_is_zero
description: Calls a helper and returns one when its result is zero, otherwise zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:90FA
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero immediately, with no other effects.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9102
name: check_path_ends_with_slash
description: Returns one when the final character of the string is a forward slash, otherwise zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9126
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero immediately, with no other effects.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9250
name: normalize_path_separators
description: Replaces every backslash in a zero-terminated string with a forward slash, in place.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:926E
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns, with no library calls, text or hardware access.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9274
name: split_path_into_parts
description: Splits a path into its device, directory and file name parts, clearing and filling each supplied buffer, and returns a value that marks where the device colon sits.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:92CA
name: copy_path_segment_or_whole
description: Copies a path into a buffer, taking either the whole string or the portion after a computed offset, and terminates it at the directory boundary.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:92E2
name: copy_path_tail_trimmed
description: Copies the remainder of a path after an offset into a buffer, then terminates it at the directory or device boundary found by scanning back for a slash or colon.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9312
name: terminate_path_parts
description: Writes terminators into path buffers at the directory and device boundaries computed from a separator offset, so the copied text is trimmed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:933E
name: terminate_device_and_dir_fields
description: Writes a terminator into the directory field when its buffer is supplied, and also terminates the device field when the character at the separator offset is a colon. The offset is clamped to twenty-nine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9400
name: find_list_entry_for_request
description: Walks a linked list of named entries and returns the first entry that matches the request, using an optional DOS pattern test and an optional case-folded copy of the name. It returns zero when no entry matches.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9424
name: find_list_entry_with_mode
description: Walks a linked list of named entries and returns the first one that compares equal to the request, copying names into stack buffers when a mode bit is set. Entries are skipped when a DOS pattern test rejects them, and zero is returned when none match.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:942E
name: find_first_entry_compare
description: Walks a linked list and returns the first entry whose name compares equal to the request, or zero when the list is exhausted. A mode flag selects between a direct compare and a case-folded compare.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:94A6
name: scan_list_for_next_match
description: Scans a linked list from the current entry and returns the next entry whose name matches the request, optionally using a DOS pattern check. Zero is returned at the end of the list.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:94BC
name: scan_list_with_dos_check
description: Checks a DOS library condition before each step through a linked list of names, returning the first entry that satisfies the comparison. Zero is returned when no entry qualifies.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:94EA
name: scan_list_for_match_loop
description: Repeatedly steps through a linked list of named entries and returns the first entry that compares equal to the request. It returns zero when the list ends without a match.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:94F2
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero immediately, with no other effects.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9590
name: append_optional_unique_entry
description: Adds a named entry to the end of a linked list. When the flag is set it first rejects duplicates, and when the list tail is missing it reports an error through the message routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:95D4
name: append_unique_list_entry
description: Scans the list for an existing entry with the same name, then allocates a new named record, zeroes it and appends it to the list. A duplicate sets a status code and no entry is added.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:95DE
name: append_list_entry_allocating
description: Allocates a named record sized to hold the name, zeroes its header, copies the name into it and appends it to the list. It sets a status code and reports an error when the allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:9606
name: append_prepared_list_entry
description: Zeroes a prepared header block, copies the given name into it, sets its entry flag and appends it to the list. The status code records success or failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:963A
name: append_entry_or_report_error
description: Appends a new entry to the tail of a linked list, and reports an internal list error through the message routine when the list has no tail.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:966C
name: append_entry_to_tail
description: Links a new entry after the current tail of a linked list and makes it the new tail, without checking whether the tail exists.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B2A0
name: open_output_file_or_report
description: Opens a named output file through a helper and reports a cannot-open message containing the file name when the open fails. It returns true when the open failed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B324
name: release_context_field_if_set
description: Calls a release helper on a context field when that field is set, and does nothing when it is zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B524
name: allocate_decoder_buffers
description: Allocates the decoder working buffers, starting with a table sized from a stored count and followed by two 128K blocks, a block sized from a stored parameter, two 32K blocks and a 4K block. It then initializes a 768-byte table, reports an error and returns one when any allocation fails, and otherwise returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B544
name: allocate_window_and_table_buffers
description: Allocates two 128K blocks, a block sized from a stored parameter, two 32K blocks and a 4K block, then initializes a 768-byte table. It reports an error and returns one when any allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B560
name: allocate_secondary_window_buffers
description: Allocates one 128K block, a block sized from a stored parameter, two 32K blocks and a 4K block, then initializes a 768-byte table. It reports an error and returns one when any allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B57C
name: allocate_block_and_tables
description: Allocates a block sized from a stored parameter, two 32K blocks and a 4K block, then initializes a 768-byte table. It reports an error and returns one when any allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B59E
name: allocate_pair_32k_then_tables
description: Copies a buffer pointer into a window slot, then allocates two 32K blocks, a 4K block and a 768-byte table, reporting an error and returning one if any allocation fails. On success it sets two pointers to the midpoints of the 128K blocks.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B5BE
name: allocate_single_32k_then_tables
description: Allocates one 32K block, a 4K block and a 768-byte table, reporting an error and returning one if any allocation fails. On success it sets two pointers to the midpoints of the 128K blocks.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B5D8
name: allocate_4k_then_table
description: Allocates a 4K block and then initializes a 768-byte table, reporting an error and returning one if the allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B5F0
name: init_table_and_finish_setup
description: Initializes a 768-byte table, then sets two pointers to the midpoints of the 128K blocks and marks the buffers ready. It returns zero on success and one when the table setup fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B60A
name: finish_buffer_setup
description: Sets two pointers to the midpoints of the 128K blocks, calls two helpers, marks the buffers ready and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B638
name: free_decoder_buffers
description: Releases every decoder buffer that is still allocated, including the table, the 128K blocks, the 32K blocks and the 4K block, clearing each stored pointer. It then reruns the 768-byte table routine and clears a ready flag.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B762
name: free_optional_block
description: Releases a memory block recorded in the context when its pointer is set, using a size stored in the context, and then clears the pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B77A
name: flush_pending_output_span
description: When the first stored position is behind the second, writes the bytes between them through a helper and reports an error if that fails. The second position is then moved up to the first.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B89E
name: write_span_with_abort_check
description: Returns one early when a status flag is clear and an abort check reports a break. Otherwise it writes the requested byte count through a helper, adds it to a running position on a full write, and returns two for a short write.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B8A4
name: flush_buffer_with_flag_one
description: Calls the buffer flush helper on a context buffer with the constant one and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B8B4
name: allocate_history_block
description: Allocates a 7,728-byte working block and, when that succeeds, stores three pointer fields into it at fixed offsets. It returns true when the allocation failed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B8CA
name: set_history_block_pointers
description: Sets three pointer fields in the context to fixed offsets within the previously allocated working block and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:B8E6
name: free_history_block
description: Releases the 7,728-byte working block when its pointer is set, then clears the pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:BCAC
name: build_doubling_run_table
description: Fills a 512-entry byte table with values that step upward in runs whose lengths double, and performs this only once per context.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:BCF4
name: fill_doubling_run_table_rest
description: Continues filling the same 512-entry table from its current position, with runs of stepping values whose lengths keep doubling.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:BD14
name: fill_alternating_run_table
description: Fills the same 512-entry table with alternating runs of values, doubling the run length on each pass, until the table is full.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:C596
name: allocate_zeroed_table_set
description: Allocates a zeroed block sized from a count and stores four table pointers into the caller's record at fixed offsets. It returns one when the allocation fails and zero on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:C5BC
name: zero_and_link_table_set
description: Zeroes a block sized from a count and stores four table pointers into the caller's record at fixed offsets. It returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:C5C8
name: fill_and_link_table_set
description: Fills a buffer with one repeated byte value and stores four table pointers into the caller's record at fixed offsets. It returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:C606
name: free_table_set
description: Releases the block referenced by a table record when it is set, using a size computed from a count, and clears the record's four table pointers.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:C874
name: invoke_raw_do_format
description: Calls the exec library's RawDoFmt entry through the global library base. The format string and its arguments are supplied by the caller and are not visible in this routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:C898
name: invoke_raw_do_format
description: Calls the exec library's RawDoFmt entry through the global library base, with its format and argument data supplied by the caller. The routine returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:D544
name: update_checksum_table_driven
description: Updates a running CRC-style checksum by stepping through the input bytes with a 256-entry lookup table, processing sixteen bytes per pass and then the remainder. It returns the complemented checksum and stores the running state.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:D63E
name: run_checksum_in_megabyte_steps
description: Clears the checksum state when given no buffer. Otherwise it steps through a byte count in one-megabyte pieces, calling a helper for each full piece and returning the helper's result for the final partial piece.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:D65A
name: step_checksum_pieces_with_remainder
description: Steps through a byte count in one-megabyte pieces, calling a helper for each piece, and handles the partial remainder with one final helper call when it is smaller than one megabyte.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:D66C
name: step_checksum_remainder_last
description: Calls a helper once per one-megabyte piece of a byte count, then makes one more helper call for the leftover bytes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E420
name: build_huffman_decode_table
description: Counts the code lengths in an input array, derives canonical code offsets and fills a decoding table with the resulting codes. The table is zeroed first for sizes other than twelve, and later stages are not visible in the shown code.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E6C0
name: run_pointer_list_handlers
description: Steps through a zero-terminated list of handler pointers, calling each one through its entry, and sets a done flag when the list ends. It returns the value of the last call made.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E6C6
name: run_pointer_list_until_done
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of handler pointers and calls each handler entry, sets a done flag once the list is exhausted, and returns the last handler result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E6F4
name: call_indirect_handler_return_constant
description: Calls a handler through a pointer stored in a global variable, passing the address of a global variable, then returns the constant twenty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E716
name: invoke_global_callback
description: Calls a function pointer stored in a global table, passing the address of a global variable as its argument, then returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E7D8
name: compare_strings_ignoring_case
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings one character at a time, converting lowercase letters to uppercase before comparing. It returns the difference at the first mismatch, or zero when the strings are equal.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E81C
name: parse_signed_decimal_value
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign followed by decimal digits from a string, storing the signed value through an address register. It returns the offset of the first character that is not a digit.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E868
name: lowercase_string_in_place
description: Converts characters flagged in a class table to lowercase in place within a zero-terminated string, and returns the string pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E874
name: lowercase_string_via_pointer
description: Converts characters flagged in a class table to lowercase in place within a zero-terminated string addressed by a pointer register. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E88E
name: write_fill_then_lowercase_run
description: Writes a fill byte at the current buffer position, then continues through the following characters and lowercases flagged letters until the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E8A0
name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Converts characters flagged in a class table to uppercase in place within a zero-terminated string, and returns the string pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E8AC
name: uppercase_string_via_pointer
description: Converts characters flagged in a class table to uppercase in place within a zero-terminated string addressed by a pointer register. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E8C6
name: write_fill_then_uppercase_run
description: Writes a fill byte at the current buffer position, then continues through the following characters and uppercases flagged letters until the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E8D8
name: free_pending_list_nodes
description: Repeatedly removes the head node from a pending list and frees it through the exec library's FreeMem entry. When the final node's size field passes a threshold it calls a second library entry, until the list is empty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E8DE
name: drain_pending_list_nodes
description: Repeatedly removes nodes from a pending list and frees each one through the exec library's FreeMem entry. When the last node's size field passes a threshold it calls a second library entry first, until the list is empty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E948
name: finish_call_with_result
description: Stores the parameter in a stack-frame slot, calls an optional handler from a context record, runs a helper, and then calls a library entry on the frame. It returns the two-word value held in the frame slot.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E950
name: split_command_line_words
description: Splits a command line into words separated by spaces, tabs or newlines, keeping double-quoted text together, and counts the words first. It then allocates a pointer array with AllocMem, fills it with the word starts and runs each registered handler on the result; inside quotes an asterisk escape turns E into escape and N into newline.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EAB4
name: free_word_array_if_set
description: Releases the parsed word-pointer array when both its count and its pointer are set, using FreeMem, and returns the library result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EAD8
name: compare_bounded_strings_signed
description: Compares up to a given number of characters of two strings and returns zero when they are equal. At the first mismatch it returns minus one if the first character is smaller and one otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EAFC
name: return_signed_comparison_result
description: Returns minus one when the processor condition flags show a signed less-or-equal result, and one otherwise. The flags are set by a comparison the caller performs, which is not shown here.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB08
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Finds the terminating zero byte of the destination buffer and copies the source string onto that position, including its terminator. It returns the original destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB20
name: copy_bounded_string_return_dest
description: Copies characters from a source string into a destination buffer up to a given count, stopping at the source terminator and zero-filling the remainder. It returns the destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB30
name: copy_bounded_string_padded
description: Copies characters from a source string into a destination buffer up to a given count, stopping at the source terminator and zero-filling the remainder. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB3A
name: zero_fill_buffer
description: Writes zero bytes into a buffer for the given count and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB44
name: check_first_char_class
description: Looks up the first byte of a string in a character class table and calls a helper when that class bit is clear. The return value is whatever the helper provides.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB78
name: run_handler_list_with_arg
description: Calls each handler in a context list through its entry pointer, then calls a helper with the parameter. It returns the helper's result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB7C
name: run_handler_list_then_helper
description: Calls each handler in a context list through its entry pointer, then calls a helper with no arguments and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EBC6
name: drain_pending_list_frame
description: Saves several context fields into a stack frame, then drains a pending list through library calls while the count is nonzero. It returns the saved pair of values.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EC50
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls another routine and then returns, with no other operations on data, registers or memory.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:0236
name: scan_arp_list_entries
description: Within the arp shared library, stores the argument in a record and fetches up to four entries from a library list through a library call. On a successful find it links a record and calls a finishing library entry, otherwise it takes the failure exit.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:0266
name: continue_arp_entry_scan
description: Within the arp shared library, continues scanning the entry list from a stored count. A found entry is linked and finished through library calls, and a missing entry takes the failure exit.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:029E
name: attach_arp_entry_record
description: Within the arp shared library, sets up a record from a given entry by storing a derived pointer and calling two library entries. It allocates a block through a library call, fills in its flags and link on success, and otherwise takes the failure exit.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:02F0
name: retry_arp_step_until_flag
description: Within the arp shared library, repeatedly calls a helper and a library entry until a flag is set. It then increments a 16-bit counter in the library record.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:0302
name: clear_arp_link_and_call
description: Within the arp shared library, clears a pointer field in the given record and calls an entry through a library pointer stored in the base record.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:046E
name: allocate_arp_linked_node
description: In the arp shared library, allocates a memory block with AllocMem when given a nonzero size, and stores a link value offset by four in its first word. Nothing is returned.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:0000
name: run_program_entry
description: Program entry point. It allocates a start-up record, copies global data into it, resolves the current directory and command-line data through DOS and exec calls, then runs the main processing and returns an eight-byte result. The code refers to the dos.library name.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:020C
name: release_message_and_resources
description: Stores a result in a stack-frame slot, calls an optional handler, then releases file locks, library bases and messages through exec and DOS library entries. It returns the frame's two-word result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:02A8
name: invoke_global_callback
description: Calls a function pointer stored in a global table, passing the address of a global variable as its argument, then returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:02AE
name: call_indirect_handler_return_constant
description: Calls a handler through a pointer stored in a global variable, passing the address of a global variable, then returns the constant twenty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:02B4
name: split_command_line_words
description: Splits a command line into words separated by spaces, tabs or newlines, keeping double-quoted text together, and counts the words first. It then allocates a pointer array with AllocMem, fills it with the word starts and runs each registered handler on the result; inside quotes an asterisk escape turns E into escape and N into newline.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:02BC
name: attempt_open_or_set_flag
description: Clears a status byte, then calls a helper with a name buffer. On failure it sets a context status flag and returns false; on success it calls two helpers and returns true.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:02FA
name: mark_status_flag_set
description: Sets a status byte in the context to one and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:0818
name: write_span_with_abort_check
description: Returns one early when a status flag is clear and an abort check reports a break. Otherwise it writes the requested byte count through a helper, adds it to a running position on a full write, and returns two for a short write.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:0836
name: check_span_write_result
description: Calls a helper with a context buffer and compares its result with an expected count. A match adds the count to a running total and returns zero, and any other result returns two.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:084E
name: add_count_to_running_total
description: Adds a count held in a register to a running total field in the context and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:142E
name: free_node_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list of nodes, calling a release helper on each node with a fixed code, then clears the list head and tail fields and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:144C
name: clear_node_list_head_tail
description: Sets the head and tail pointers of a context list to zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:162C
name: pack_option_flags_into_byte
description: Builds one byte of option bits from eight context flag bytes, setting each bit whose source flag is nonzero, and stores it through the output pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:51C8
name: apply_lzx_option_switch
description: Handles one command-line option letter by setting the matching context field. Numeric arguments are converted through a helper and clamped to fixed ranges, and an unknown letter reports an error through the message routine and returns one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5B7C
name: next_option_argument_text
description: Advances through an argument vector, recording the first option letter and returning the text that follows it, or zero when the vector is exhausted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5B82
name: next_option_argument_text
description: Advances through an argument vector, recording the first option letter and returning the text that follows it, or zero when the vector is exhausted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5C24
name: next_nonoption_argument
description: Returns the next argument from a vector. Dash-prefixed arguments are skipped unless a double-dash has been seen, and zero is returned when the vector is exhausted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5C8E
name: parse_slash_separated_triple
description: Parses a slash-separated triple from a string: a value between 1970 and 2099 that is stored as a letter offset, followed by two bounded numbers. It returns one when any field is missing or out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5CBA
name: parse_slash_separated_triple
description: Parses a slash-separated triple from a string: a value between 1970 and 2099 that is stored as a letter offset, followed by two bounded numbers. It returns one when any field is missing or out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5CD2
name: parse_month_day_fields
description: Skips a leading slash, then parses a month between one and twelve and a day between one and thirty-one from a slash-separated string, storing each in a record. It returns one when a field is missing or out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5CE4
name: parse_month_and_day_tail
description: Parses a month between one and twelve and then a day between one and thirty-one from a slash-separated string. It returns one when a field is missing or out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5D00
name: parse_day_after_separator
description: Scans forward to the next slash, skips it, and parses a day between one and thirty-one into a record. It returns one when the day is missing or out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5D0E
name: parse_day_field_after_slash
description: Skips a leading slash and parses a day between one and thirty-one into a record. It returns one when the day is missing or out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5D20
name: store_day_field_value
description: Calls a helper to obtain a number and stores it as a day field, returning one when the value is zero or above thirty-one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5D3C
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero immediately, with no other effects.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5D44
name: initialize_default_options
description: Sets the default option and buffer-size fields in the context, copies a default name string into a context buffer, and selects a size value from a mode byte. It returns that default size selector.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5E10
name: handle_pause_request
description: Adjusts the task priority through exec when a flag is set and toggles a state byte. When a pause flag is set it shows the paused prompt text and waits for input before returning the state.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5E8C
name: check_first_char_class
description: Looks up the first byte of a string in a character class table and calls a helper when that class bit is clear. The return value is whatever the helper provides.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5E92
name: run_handler_list_with_arg
description: Calls each handler in a context list through its entry pointer, then calls a helper with the parameter. It returns the helper's result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5E98
name: initialize_and_run_step
description: Runs three setup helpers, then calls a helper with the value one hundred when a mode byte is below two. It installs a callback pointer, runs a helper and finishes with a status helper, returning zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:5FEC
name: detect_environment_mode
description: Looks up the current task and opens the arp library when a version field meets a threshold, otherwise it flags the task. It then records a mode byte from the task's flag bits.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:607A
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls another routine and then returns, with no other operations on data, registers or memory.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:6080
name: save_and_clear_task_field
description: Saves a field of a task record into a context slot, overwrites that field with minus one, and sets a status flag.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:70A8
name: format_temp_file_name
description: Formats a temporary file name from a prefix and a numeric suffix derived from a stored value, using the referenced name pattern, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7B74
name: open_named_file_for_mode
description: Clears a 144-byte block, then maps a mode string onto a mode code by comparing it with three known names. An unknown mode is reported through the message routine, and the file is opened with the chosen code, storing the handle through the output pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7BAC
name: open_file_mode_from_name
description: Maps a mode string onto a mode code by comparing it with two known names, reporting an unknown mode through the message routine. It then opens the file and stores the handle through the output pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7BC6
name: open_file_mode_either_name
description: Maps a mode string onto a mode code when it matches either of two known names, reporting an unknown mode through the message routine otherwise. It then opens the file and stores the handle through the output pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7BE0
name: open_file_mode_single_name
description: Maps a mode string onto a mode code when it matches a single known name, reporting an unknown mode through the message routine otherwise. It then opens the file and stores the handle through the output pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7BFA
name: open_file_with_mode_code
description: Reports a fixed message, then opens the file using the current mode code and stores the handle through the output pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7C34
name: store_handle_or_release
description: Calls a library entry and stores its nonzero result through the output pointer. When the result is zero it calls a second library entry to release resources, and it returns true when the first call failed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7C4A
name: store_data_register_through_pointer
description: Writes a data register value through an address register pointer and returns zero. It is a single store with no library calls, text or hardware access.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7C50
name: open_dos_file_handle
description: Calls the DOS library's Open entry through the library base and stores the returned handle through the caller's pointer when the result is nonzero. It returns true when the open call returned zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7C66
name: store_data_register_via_pointer
description: Writes a data register value through an address register pointer and returns zero, with no other effects. The same pattern appears as a small field store used by several callers.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7C70
name: close_handle_and_clear_record
description: If the handle pointer's stored value is nonzero, closes it through the DOS library; otherwise it reports the internal error text that a file handle was already closed. It then zeroes a 144-byte record starting at the same pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7C88
name: close_file_and_clear_buffer
description: Closes a file through the DOS library's Close entry and then zeroes 144 bytes starting at the pointer held in an address register. It returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7CAA
name: read_or_return_zero
description: Returns zero without reading when the requested length is not positive; otherwise it forwards the arguments to the DOS Read entry and returns its result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7CC2
name: forward_read_to_dos
description: Calls the DOS library's Read entry through the library base and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7D28
name: forward_write_to_dos
description: Calls the DOS library's Write entry through the library base with the arguments it was given, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:7FB0
name: cache_standard_input_output_handles
description: Stores the DOS standard input handle in a context record. It also stores the standard output handle unless a suppression flag byte is set, in which case it stores zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:809E
name: invoke_dos_vector_if_clear
description: Calls one DOS library vector only when a context flag byte is clear, and does nothing otherwise. The evidence does not name the library function that is invoked.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:80C0
name: cleanup_and_report_user_abort
description: Runs a cleanup routine and then the error reporting routine with the global message buffer. The referenced text is the LZX user-abort notice.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:80D0
name: emit_message_five_set_flag
description: When a status byte is clear, calls the message routine with the global message buffer and code five, then sets a second status byte to one. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:80EC
name: emit_message_four_clear_flag
description: When a status byte is clear, calls the message routine with the global message buffer and code four, then clears a second status byte. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8106
name: write_to_output_when_enabled
description: Writes through the DOS library's Write entry only when a suppression flag is clear and the stored output handle is nonzero. It does nothing otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8134
name: write_bytes_in_chunks
description: When output is enabled and an output handle is set, writes the requested byte count in pieces of at most 1024 bytes through DOS Write. It calls an intermediate check between pieces and returns eleven if that check fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8158
name: write_chunks_checking_between
description: Writes the requested byte count in pieces of at most 1024 bytes through DOS Write, calling a check after each piece except the last. It returns eleven if a check reports failure and zero when the count is drained.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8164
name: write_fixed_blocks_until_done
description: Writes blocks of 1024 bytes through DOS Write and calls a check between blocks until the remaining count is exhausted. It returns zero on completion and eleven when the check reports failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:818C
name: format_and_write_message
description: When output is enabled and an output handle is set, formats a text line into a context buffer using a helper routine, then writes it through DOS Write with the length measured from its terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:81CE
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns, with no library calls, text or hardware access.
